message.content: The color of the sea can vary widely depending on factors such as depth, clarity, time of day, weather conditions, and the presence of algae or sediment. In general, it ranges from deep blues near the horizon to turquoise or greenish hues closer to shore, especially where sunlight penetrates more easily.
